work.summary: Built and deployed end-to-end AI systems, including real-time face recognition and people tracking optimized with ONNX/TensorRT for edge and cloud, LLM-based RAG chatbots for retail personalization, and internal tools for dataset management, annotation quality, and model monitoring to ensure reliable ML workflows.

work.name: Ping4All
work.summary: Built a production-grade computer vision system for sports analytics, leveraging CUDA, PyTorch, C++/PyBind11, and multiprocessing to optimize real-time inference and latency, training and scaling experiments on HPC clusters with SLURM, and deploying Dockerized models on AWS with job scheduling, monitoring, and system-level orchestration for reliable AI infrastructure.

work.name: RICS(Research and Innovation Center in Computer Science)
work.summary: Designed, implemented, and fine-tuned deep learning models for NLP using PyTorch, performing data analysis and visualization in Python within Dockerized environments, authoring peer-reviewed research papers, presenting results at conferences, and collaborating with multidisciplinary research teams to deliver reproducible and impactful NLP research.

work.name: Freelance Machine Learning Engineer
